name: intent-ledger
description: Intent Ledger: a live pane of what the agent is aiming for, assuming, planning and deciding, so you can watch its intent and correct a wrong assumption early

instructAgent.title: Ask the agent to keep the ledger
instructAgent.description: Add a short system-prompt section asking the agent to log its goal, assumptions, plan, decisions, questions, risks and findings through the ledger tool. Also needed for the 'changed files with nothing logged' warning

autoAllow.title: Allow the ledger tool without asking
autoAllow.description: The ledger tool only writes to this pane. When on, its calls skip the permission prompt; every other tool is untouched

observePlans.title: Read visible plans
observePlans.description: Fold todo lists, task lists and approved plan-mode plans into the ledger's plan

staleAfterTurns.title: Stale after (turns)
staleAfterTurns.description: An assumption still unverified this many turns after it was logged is flagged stale (0 turns the flag off)

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (wide terminals and the desktop app)

palette.title: Colour palette
palette.description: Colours for the pane text and diagrams: default follows your Claude Code theme; the others are fixed editor palettes (Catppuccin, Dracula, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Nord, Solarized, Rosé Pine)

brandAccent.title: Brand accent on headers
brandAccent.description: With the default palette, colour the pane headers in Claude orange. Off, headers use your terminal's own text colour (named palettes use their own accent)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show open and stale assumptions, invalidated ones, plan progress and open questions in the status line
